authority_rules: Wardrobe ownership remains player_wardrobe.item_id; equipped wardrobe state remains player_appearance slot_id.
Stone/board skins use a server-authoritative ownership contract and presentation-only selected state; no automatic grant is added.
Existing effect-bearing appearance effects are preserved but quarantined; they are not monetization-eligible and are not approved cosmetic power.
Cosmetic presentation must not become combat authority; functional equipment remains player_inventory + server EQUIPMENT_DEFS.
No weapon cosmetic record may be reconciled with functional equipment by display name, art, or slot.
